leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a readable stream to read data from a file
Construct a writable stream to write data to a file
Configure a transform stream to modify data during processing
Integrate multiple streams using pipe() for data flow
Manipulate stream events to handle data, end, and error scenarios
Initialize a duplex stream for bidirectional data communication
Control stream flow using pause() and resume() methods
